hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git commit"*) BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); case "$BRANCH" in develop|master|main|release*|staging) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ❌ 禁止在受保护分支 $BRANCH 上直接 commit 改动！新改动必须在临时分支提交，再经 merge 合入。" >&2; exit 1;; esac;; *"git merge"*|*"git push"*) BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); case "$BRANCH" in develop|master|main|release*|staging) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ⚠️ 受保护分支 $BRANCH 上的 merge/push —— 必须经人类明确授权方可执行；未授权请停下确认。" >&2;; esac;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git push"*"--force"*|*"git push"*"--force-with-lease"*|*"git push"*"-f"*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ❌ force push / force-with-lease（历史改写）永久禁止！" >&2; exit 1;; *"git push"*"--delete"*|*"git push"*" :"*) case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *" :develop"*|*" :master"*|*" :main"*|*" :release"*|*" :staging"*|*"--delete develop"*|*"--delete master"*|*"--delete main"*|*"--delete release"*|*"--delete staging"*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ❌ 删除受保护远程分支（develop/master/main/release*/staging）永久禁止！" >&2; exit 1;; *) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ⚠️ 删除临时远程分支——必须经人类明确授权并确认已合并。" >&2;; esac;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git rebase"*) BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); case "$BRANCH" in develop|master|main|release*|staging) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ❌ 禁止在受保护分支 $BRANCH 上执行 rebase！请使用 merge。" >&2; exit 1;; esac;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"rm -rf"*|*"rm -r "*|*"rm -fr"*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ⚠️ 检测到 rm -rf 递归删除，请确认目标路径非核心系统/项目源码目录！" >&2;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git reset --hard"*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ⚠️ git reset --hard 会永久丢弃工作区改动！未确认请勿执行。" >&2;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git add -A"*|*"git add ."*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] ⚠️ 严禁 git add . 全量盲目暂存（防止误带入编译产物与临时文件），请改用 git add <明确路径>！" >&2;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *".pro"*|*"CMakeLists.txt"*|*"package.json"*|*"Cargo.toml"*|*"pom.xml"*|*"public_struct.h"*|*"protofile/"*|*"license"*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] 🔴 触碰高风险文件（构建配置/公共结构/协议定义/授权许可）——请先阅读 .agents/rules/security-boundary.md 并向人类确认影响面！" >&2;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *".pem"*|*".key"*|*".token"*|*"credentials"*|*"id_rsa"*|*"secret"*) echo "[SECURITY-HOOK] 🔐 敏感凭证防护——严禁在代码与配置中明文硬编码密钥！" >&2;; esac
